fullDescription: A light-mode neumorphic (Soft UI) design system for productivity tools and AI interfaces. Featuring a tactile, 'skeuomorphic-lite' aesthetic with extruded and inset shadows, it utilizes a neutral gray base (#ebecf0) with vibrant emerald and amber accents. Ideal for SaaS dashboards, prompt engineering tools, and data-entry platforms where focus and visual softness are required. Includes bento-style grids and high-radius rounded corners.
prompt:
## Resumo
A clean, modern neumorphic interface designed for clarity and depth. It uses soft shadows and light-source positioning to create a physical, tactile surface feel. The layout is structured as a two-column grid with generous white space and high-contrast typography for readability.

## Estilo Visual
Create a UI using a Light Neumorphic aesthetic. ### Colors: Background: #ebecf0; Surface Shadow: #babecc; Surface Highlight: #ffffff; Text: #444444 (Primary), #64748b (Secondary); Accent 1 (Success): #10b981; Accent 2 (Warning): #f59e0b. ### Typography: Headings in 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (Weight 700-800), Body in 'DM Sans' (Weight 400-500). ### Elevation Styles: 1. Extruded: box-shadow: 6px 6px 12px #babecc, -6px -6px 12px #ffffff; 2. Inset: box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 8px #babecc, inset -4px -4px 8px #ffffff; 3. Convex: box-shadow: 5px 5px 10px #babecc, -5px -5px 10px #ffffff. All containers must have rounded corners between 24px and 40px.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
A horizontal navigation bar with a logo area on the left and utility buttons on the right. The logo should sit inside a 48x48px 'neu-convex' square with 16px border-radius. Action buttons should be rounded-full with 'neu-convex' styling and subtle active-state transitions.

### Primary Interaction Area
A large 'neu-extruded' card (border-radius: 40px, padding: 40px). Inside, include a label row followed by a large text area housed within a 'neu-inset' container (#f0f2f5). The text area should have no borders, using the inset shadow for depth. A primary action button should be right-aligned at the bottom.

### Information Grid
A section titled 'Recent Activity' or similar, featuring a grid of 'neu-extruded' cards. These cards should have 'neu-extruded-hover' effects (increasing shadow size to 8px 16px) to indicate interactivity. Use a 2-column grid layout for desktop.

### Sidebar Widgets
A collection of vertically stacked cards. Top card: 'Tips' section using 'neu-extruded' base with inner 'neu-inset' content blocks for individual tips. Bottom card: A 'Metrics' widget showing a progress bar inside a 'neu-inset' track (height: 8px) with a solid emerald fill.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Accent Glow Primary Button — A neumorphic button with an emerald glow effect and active state.
Style a button with 'neu-convex' elevation. Background: #ebecf0; Text: #059669; Border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1). Add a 'box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.1)' to create a soft outer glow. On click/active: apply 'box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 5px #babecc, inset -2px -2px 5px #ffffff' to simulate a physical button press.

### Progress Score Tracker — A statistical component combining neumorphic depth with flat color indicators.
Create a score widget using 'neu-convex' card styling. Display a label and percentage value. Below text, create a 'neu-inset' track (bg: #e2e8f0, rounded-full). Inside, place a flat 'bg-emerald-500' bar whose width corresponds to the score percentage.

## Notas Especiais
MUST DO: Maintain strict background-color consistency (#ebecf0) across the entire page for the neumorphic shadows to work. MUST NOT: Use borders or flat solid shadows. MUST NOT: Mix high-contrast dark modes; this is strictly a light-source-dependent design. Use subtle color shifts like #f8fafc for inset backgrounds to differentiate them from the main surface.

style.description: The style is defined by 'Neumorphism' using #ebecf0 as the background. Typography pairs 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for bold, structural headings and 'DM Sans' for legible body text.
